Messages.Author: Yod X
Messages.Body:
Suppose I have 6 points of influence on Gilbert Duane in my uncontrolled
region but Gilbert is already a ready minion of an opponent. Could I take
control of Gilbert in the following way:

1) Play Malkavian Dementia to take control of opponent's Gilbert
2) Put the 7th blood on my Gilbert putting me in contention with myself
3) Decide that I don't like contending with myself and burn *my
opponent's* Gilbert

Is this legal/will it work?! A lot of hassle I'll agree but as Malkie's
are a rather popular clan...

Jeff Ingalls (yo...@aol.com)

--Self/Pocahontas

Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
Yod X (yo...@aol.com) wrote:
: Suppose I have 6 points of influence on Gilbert Duane in my uncontrolled

: region but Gilbert is already a ready minion of an opponent. Could I take
: control of Gilbert in the following way:

: 1) Play Malkavian Dementia to take control of opponent's Gilbert
: 2) Put the 7th blood on my Gilbert putting me in contention with myself
: 3) Decide that I don't like contending with myself and burn *my
: opponent's* Gilbert

no this won't work. You can only bring out your Gilbert at the end of
your turn. You can only give up a contested card during your untap phase
however the Malkavian Dementia card says to return control of the vampire
at the beginning of the untap phase. Therefore you can't give up his
copy of Gilbert since you no longer have it.

Much better way is to steal a full malkavian and minion tap it (if you
have Rumors of Gehenna or Anson) then diablerize a vampire and call a
bloodhunt to destroy the vampire (I've had it happen to me before so
don't say it can't happen. More insulting was that it was Gilbert and he
voted to burn himself!)

Hope this helps

Jeff

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <3t0sir$m...@newsbf02.news.aol.com>, Yod X <yo...@aol.com> wrote:
>Suppose I have 6 points of influence on Gilbert Duane in my uncontrolled
>region but Gilbert is already a ready minion of an opponent. Could I take
>control of Gilbert in the following way:
>
>1) Play Malkavian Dementia to take control of opponent's Gilbert
>2) Put the 7th blood on my Gilbert putting me in contention with myself
>3) Decide that I don't like contending with myself and burn *my
>opponent's* Gilbert
>

No. You only control a demented malkavian "until your next untap phase".
You can't yield anything except *during* your untap phase, which is
after the point at which you lost control of the Demented Malk.
